title: SWITCH with no match and no else returns BLANK
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( Product[Color] ), "Code", SWITCH ( Product[Color], "Red", 1, "Blue", 2 ) )

source.quote: If none of the values match and else isn’t specified, BLANK is returned.
source.supports: no match and no else is BLANK

derivation: Green matches neither "Red" nor "Blue" and there is no else argument, so its code is BLANK.
